title: I added cosmetic ship skins to Slingshot Speeders
author: jaykrown
selftext:
The first orbital racing game now has a premium and free cosmetics shop. This is the anime ship skin for the Founder's Pack Spear exclusive hull.  The current version is the test before the full v0.2.0 wipe and update to Season Zero. I look forward to seeing the first orbital racing champion!

Free to play in browser no account required. [https://slingshotspeeders.com/](https://slingshotspeeders.com/)

comments.author: johnnydotexe
comments.body: Looks like Delta V: Rings of Saturn.

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body: That game looks great, thank you. Alas, ΔV: Rings of Saturn is focused solely on mining in deep space with no gravitational forces. Slingshot Speeders, the first orbital racing game, uses a proper inverse square gravity simulation and orbital mechanic trajectory calculations along with the proper rocket equation.

comments.author: HaphazardlyOrganized
comments.body: So is scoring time + delta v remaining?

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body: Indeed, the score attempts to quantify the efficiency of the run. But, there is also of course the ability to sort the leaderboards by time and delta V specifically. Several players have tried to win using the least amount of fuel, most players have tried to win getting the fastest time. I have not played New Orbit, but I have 200 hours in Kerbal Space Program, 97 hours in Kerbal Space Program 2, 11 hours in Juno: New Origins, and 5 hours in Flight of Nova. Thanks for commenting, and if you play and have any suggestions or issues it really helps if you let me know, so please do!

replies.author: HaphazardlyOrganized
replies.body:
i'm MX on the leaderboards lol, this is very neat and as someone who's also spent a lot of time in ksp I'm excited to see more games with orbital mechanics!.

I was a bit confused by main, rcs, and burn, both what I was changing and if there was a keybinding that would let me switch. A tutorial level might help

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body: Thanks for testing and I appreciate you mentioning that. I plan on making a short video explainer which can easily be viewed in game. I just made changes to the scoring system to be MUCH better. I hope to see you become the orbital racing champion.
